recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I later decides to make GraphQL mandatory/modifier behavior stronger than the existing client SHOULD guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-19659 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-I and asked that the GraphQL section add guidance equivalent to the _elements rule so clients are aware that mandatory and is-modifier elements need to be included when requesting partial resource content.
initial_application: Git commit 7d847aa27b5977a707e4ce6ddd33141b0c05d61e explicitly applied FHIR-19659 by adding a GraphQL conformance paragraph saying GraphQL requests select subsets of resources and clients SHOULD always retrieve mandatory and modifier elements and check their values. The current source and combined branch retain that paragraph.
additional_context: source/graphql.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml under the RESTful API page hierarchy, and the implementing commit is contained in the v5.0.0 tag, matching the Jira Applied for Version R5. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision; a later Zulip discussion about _elements and GraphQL reinforces the same safety concern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current GraphQL source already satisfies the issue request.
